# LibAtrac9

ATRAC9 decoder by Alex Barney, https://github.com/Thealexbarney/LibAtrac9,
commit efca2e3af35562a09a9bb6deed90e45b4b824dc4.

`src/` holds the upstream `C/src` files unmodified and `LICENSE` is the
upstream MIT license. Keep both byte-identical to upstream; emulator-specific
behavior belongs in the code that calls the decoder.
